{{Quote|Our lines are broken and the battle is lost! What is your will, my Emperor? Retreat or fight to the death?|Master Rand Ko|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
The '''Battle of Borosk''' was an engagement caused by the resurrected [[Darth Krayt]]'s military push across the galaxy. Following [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk's]] capture by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] in a [[Battle of Borosk (137 ABY)|previous battle]], the planet's control had gone back and forth between Fel and Krayt. By [[138 ABY]], the planet was back under the control of [[Empire-in-exile|Fel loyalist]] forces.

However, when the Sith-Imperial forces returned to take the planet, the Bastion forces were overwhelmed. Master [[Rand Ko]], the [[Imperial Knight]] commanding Fel's forces, was ordered to retreat by his [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. As [[Roan Fel]] finished delivering his orders the [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] link between Fel and Ko was cut short. The last Fel saw of his loyal Imperial Knight was him being attacked by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].
